info.name: RentNest - Rental Property Marketplace API
info.description:
# RentNest API Collection

Postman collection built to match the actual RentNest server (`src/`). Import this file into Postman, set the **`baseUrl`** variable if your server runs somewhere other than `http://localhost:5000` (default port from `.env`: **5000**).

## 🔐 Auth = Cookies (NOT Bearer tokens)

- `POST /api/auth/register` and `POST /api/auth/login` set **httpOnly cookies** (`accessToken` + `refreshToken`).
- Postman's **cookie jar automatically stores and resends them** for the `localhost` domain, so protected routes work with **no manual token setup**.
- No `Authorization` header is needed anywhere in this collection.
- If a request returns `401`, just run **Login** again (or **Refresh Token**) and Postman will pick up the fresh cookies.

## Response format

Every endpoint returns:

```json
{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "...",
  "data": { ... }
}
```

## Rules to remember

- Register password: **at least 8 chars, 2+ digits, 1+ special char** (example: `Secret@123`).
- Only a **tenant** can submit rental requests & reviews.
- Only a **landlord/admin** can create/update/delete properties and approve/reject requests.
- Only an **admin** can access `/api/admin/*`.
- Payment can only be created for a rental request that is `approved`.

## Flows covered

1. **🏠 Tenant Journey** – Register → Browse → View property → Submit request → Wait for approval → Make payment (Stripe/SSLCommerz) → Leave review.
2. **🏘️ Landlord Journey** – Register → Create listing → View requests → Approve/Reject → Manage properties.
3. **📊 Rental Request Status** – PENDING → APPROVED / REJECTED → PAYMENT → ACTIVE → COMPLETED.

## Suggested test order

1. Run **2.1 Register Landlord** then **2.3 Create Property Listing** (grab `propertyId` & `categoryId` from responses).
2. Run **1.1 Register Tenant**, **1.3 Browse Properties**, **1.5 Submit Rental Request** (grab `rentalId`).
3. Run **2.5 Approve Rental Request**.
4. Run **1.7 Make Payment (Stripe)** → **1.9 Confirm Payment** (rental becomes `active`).
5. Run **1.10 Leave Review**.

item.name: 🏠 1. Tenant Journey

request.description:
Register a new **tenant**. Sets `accessToken` + `refreshToken` **httpOnly cookies** automatically. Response also contains `data.user` and `data.accessToken`.

> ⚠️ Password must contain ≥8 chars, 2+ digits, and 1+ special char (e.g. `Secret@123`).
Login the tenant. Sets auth cookies. Banned accounts get `403 Your account has been banned`.
Public. Get all properties. Grab a `data[].id` and set it into the `propertyId` variable.
Public. View one property. Also available: `GET {{baseUrl}}/api/properties/{{propertyId}}/reviews`.

Tenant submits a rental request → status starts at **PENDING**. Requires cookies from 1.1/1.2.

- Property must exist and be `available`.
- You cannot rent your own property. Grab the new rental's `data.id` into `rentalId`.
Poll the rental request. Wait until the landlord approves it → status **approved** before paying.

Create a payment for an **approved** rental using Stripe. Amount is taken automatically from the property price.

- With no `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` configured the server returns a **mock** payment + `clientSecret`.
- Save the returned `data.payment.id` into `paymentId`.
Alternative to Stripe: create an SSLCommerz payment record for an approved rental.
Confirm/verify a payment. On success the payment becomes `completed` and the rental status moves to **ACTIVE**.
Tenant leaves a review for a property. `rating` is 1–5. One review per (tenant, property) — a duplicate returns an error.

item.description: Register → Browse Properties → View Property Details → Submit Request → Wait for Approval → Make Payment (Stripe/SSLCommerz) → Leave Review

item.name: 🏘️ 2. Landlord Journey

request.description: Register a new **landlord**. Sets auth cookies for the landlord.
Login the landlord. This overwrites the cookie jar with the landlord session.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Modern 2BR Apartment in Dhanmondi",
  "description": "Fully furnished 2 bedroom apartment with balcony and parking.",
  "location": "Dhanmondi, Dhaka",
  "price": 12000,
  "bedrooms": 2,
  "bathrooms": 2,
  "area": 1200,
  "amenities": ["WiFi", "Parking", "Elevator", "AC"],
  "images": ["https://example.com/apartment1.jpg"],
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}"
}

request.description:
Create a new property listing (landlord/admin). Requires cookies from 2.1/2.2.

- `categoryId` is **required** → get it from `GET {{baseUrl}}/api/categories` and set the `categoryId` variable.
- Save the returned `data.id` into the `propertyId` variable.
Get all rental requests for the landlord's properties (typically **pending** ones).
Approve a **pending** rental request → status **approved**. The property is automatically marked `rented`.
Reject a **pending** rental request → status **rejected**.
Update a property listing. All fields are optional (partial update).
Remove a property listing. ⚠️ Destructive action.
List the landlord's own property listings.

item.description: Register → Create Listings → View Requests → Approve/Reject → Manage Properties

item.name: 📊 3. Rental Request Status Lifecycle

request.description: New rental request → **PENDING**.
Landlord approves → **APPROVED** (use landlord session). Alternative branch: **REJECTED** via `{"status":"rejected"}`.
Create payment intent (Stripe/SSLCommerz) → payment status **pending**. Then call **1.9 Confirm Payment** to finish.
Confirm payment → payment `completed`, rental → **ACTIVE** (move-in).

The API exposes `completed`/`cancelled` statuses in the schema, but no endpoint sets them. Once the rental is **ACTIVE**, simulate completion by updating the DB directly (`UPDATE rental_requests SET status='completed' WHERE id='{{rentalId}}'`), then verify via this GET.

item.description:
State machine: PENDING → APPROVED / REJECTED → PAYMENT → ACTIVE → COMPLETED.

Run these in order using the same `rentalId`. The landlord session (folder 2) is needed for approve/reject.

request.description: Register a user. `role` is optional (defaults to `tenant`). Sets auth cookies.
Login → sets cookies. Returns `data.user` (without password).
Rotates the refresh token and returns a new access token. Use this if a request returned `401`.
Revokes the refresh token and clears cookies.
Get the currently authenticated user profile. (Same as `GET {{baseUrl}}/api/user/me`.)
Public. Get all properties.
Public. Get one property.
Public. Get reviews for a property.
Public. Get all categories. Copy a category `data.id` into the `categoryId` variable (needed to create a property).
Tenant submits a rental request. Only tenants (401/403 otherwise).
Get the current user's rental requests (tenants see their own; landlords see requests on their properties).
Get one rental request and its current status.
Create a Stripe payment for an approved rental. Tenant/admin only. Returns `data.payment` and (if Stripe is configured) a `clientSecret`.
Create an SSLCommerz payment record for an approved rental.
Confirm a payment → `completed`, and the linked rental becomes **ACTIVE**.
Get the current user's payment history.
Get one payment's details.

Stripe webhook endpoint (registered before `express.json()`, expects a raw JSON body). Only works when Stripe + webhook secret are configured; otherwise returns `500`. Useful for testing the async `payment_intent.succeeded` path with the Stripe CLI (`stripe listen --forward-to localhost:5000/api/payments/webhook`).
Tenant creates a review. `rating` must be 1–5. One review per tenant+property (unique constraint).
List the landlord's own properties.

request.description: Get all rental requests for the landlord's properties.
Approve (`approved`) or reject (`rejected`) a pending rental request. Only `pending` → `approved`/`rejected` is allowed.
All users. Admin only.
Ban/unban a user. `status` is `active` or `banned`. Admin only.
All property listings. Admin only.
All rental requests. Admin only.
Create a property category. Admin only.
